mechanism: Bumetanide causes electrolyte depletion and volume depletion which can potentiate tolterodine's anticholinergic effects and increase risk of urinary retention; tolterodine may reduce urine output counteracting diuretic efficacy.
action: Monitor fluid balance, electrolytes (especially potassium), and post-void residual volumes; assess for urinary retention and adjust tolterodine dose if needed; ensure adequate hydration.
